entities.name: Neslihan Arın
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Neslihan Arın is a Turkish badminton player. She won the women's singles title at the 2013 Islamic Solidarity Games; 2013, 2018, 2022 Mediterranean Games and the women's doubles title at the 2013 Mediterranean Games. Arın also won the bronze medals at the 2015 European Games and at the 2021, 2022 and 2024 European Championships
